name: Fairmont La Hacienda Costa Del Sol
positioning: Fairmont La Hacienda Costa del Sol, a beachfront golf resort in San Roque on the Mediterranean coast of southern Spain
best_for: Golfers who want courses with views of the Rock of Gibraltar
Travelers who want a beach resort on a quieter stretch of coast

facts.text: The resort sits on the Mediterranean coast of southern Spain between Sotogrande and La Línea, in a part of the coast that is less known and less developed than nearby resort areas.
The golf courses have views of the Rock of Gibraltar, the Costa del Sol and, in the distance, Morocco.
The resort's architecture is by dAAr studio, with terraces and steps built on a hillside between the main building and the freestanding villas.
The interiors are by Studio Ibu and use natural materials such as Campaspero limestone, noble woods, and jute and linen textiles.
All rooms have terraces with views of the sea, the golf courses, or the large swimming pool.
El Faro de la Hacienda serves breakfast, lunch and dinner.
The spa area includes hammams, a sauna, hydrotherapy, a snow fountain and a yoga studio.
Spa treatments use products from Subtle Energies and 111Skincare.
Gibraltar International Airport is about a 25-minute drive from the resort.
The resort has a network of paths for buggies, available to guests 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: The resort has direct access to La Alcaidesa beach, a sandy beach with the Punta Carbonera lighthouse.
Guests can book tee times on the Links and Heathland golf courses, designed by Peter Alliss, Clive Clark and Kurtis Bowman.
Chef Benito Gómez, behind Bardal in Ronda, is in charge of the restaurant Dalmar, which serves food for sharing in a relaxed atmosphere.
Guests can book yacht trips from the port of Sotogrande and sail among dolphins.
A sculpture of a whale's tail stands in the middle of the lobby.

considerations.text: Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport is about a 1 hour 20-minute drive from the resort.
Airport and station transfers need to be booked 48 hours prior to arrival.
Parking at the resort is available for an additional fee.
